results.name: AI capabilities follow actual backend gates instead of old future-feature constants
create/status retain separate canonical task and Agent states
reject malformed identities, events, duplicate Agents and late confirmation
accept canonical evidence-bound design and reject invented or unsupported IDs
reject publication before user acceptance or despite uncertainty/review failure
creation sends trimmed explicit brief and original idempotency key; ignores server task URLs
local input guards block empty, long, invalid styles and path identifiers before network
status cursor, confirm sequence and cancel sequence use correct server APIs
typed backend failures and malformed results do not silently create replacement tasks
10-second workflow timeout makes one request only (accelerated clock)
empty creation stays local; draft submit is not an Agent network action
lost creation reply offers same-body same-key manual retry despite edited input
real returned Agent snapshot drives cards; repeated events are deduplicated
poll queries do not overlap; hidden page pauses automatic queries
lost status connection preserves last confirmed Agent state, pauses polling and never resubmits
outdated status snapshot cannot rewind a displayed stage
awaiting confirmation displays verified text and safe references; export stays disabled
final acceptance sends current confirmation and sequence; server-confirmed export becomes available
culture hold cannot be accepted or exported; no model request follows a state query
refresh restores only the task ID via free GET and does not re-create a paid task
invalid saved task identifier is ignored without a network call
unknown saved task is clearly invalidated; next explicit creation does not inherit its ID
cancel request preserves real running stage until backend marks task cancelled
automatic status polling is bounded and ends without inventing a task failure
HTML binding/version chain and only safe text construction (static)
